name: Second Sight Spirits
limitations: Public website information; no on-site audit. The one-floor/no-steps statement is the operator’s description of the distillery, not an observed continuous route from parking. Entrance thresholds, door controls, designated parking, toilet/changing facilities, seating clearances, quiet spaces, communication supports and assistance remain unverified. The FAQ says the venue is not dog friendly but does not explain service-animal arrangements; no service-animal exclusion is inferred. Confirm the date, tour or lounge service and required arrangements before travelling.
facts: The distillery’s FAQ describes the whole distillery as one floor without steps. It does not describe the street-to-door connection, doorway controls or restroom layout.
Our distillery is wheelchair friendly, the whole distillery is on one floor without steps making it easy for our friends to navigate our space.
Reservations are recommended for tours and tastings because tours can fill. The venue says it will try to fit in callers or walk-ins; this is not a guaranteed place.
Do I need a reservation for a tasting or tour? Reservations are recommended as our tours can fill up but it never hurts to call or show up. We’ll do our best to fit you in.

The FAQ describes Thursday tours without lounge coffee or cocktail service, and Friday–Sunday tours and bar service. Confirm your selected date and booking; the Thursday visit is not described as a full lounge visit.
We also offer a midweek tour on Thursdays but our lounge will not be open for coffee and cocktails during that time.
Second Sight Spirits is open on Thursdays for tours and Fridays, Saturdays, and Sundays for tour and bar service.
Visitors may bring their own food. The FAQ says there is no restaurant, while noting that treats from local companies are brought in; confirm what is available and any ingredient needs directly.
We do not have a restaurant but we do bring in treats from local companies like North South Baking. You are free to bring in your own food as well.

The FAQ offers a tasting for visitors who do not have time for a full tour and says guests may wait in the lounge when staff are busy. It does not specify a tasting duration, wait time or seating configuration.
We also offer tastings if you do no have time for a tour.
If we’re busy, feel free to grab a cocktail and relax in our lounge while you wait and we’ll take care of you as soon as we can!
